source.author: verg
source.text: Huc septem Aeneas collectis navibus omni ex numero subit; ac magno telluris amore egressi optata potiuntur Troes harena, et sale tabentis artus in litore ponunt.
source.text_original: Huc septem Aeneas collectis navibus omni / ex numero subit; ac magno telluris amore / egressi optata potiuntur Troes harena, / et sale tabentis artus in litore ponunt.
source.text_english: Here Aeneas comes up with seven ships gathered from the whole fleet; and, having disembarked with great longing for land, the Trojans gain the desired shore and lay their salt-drenched limbs on the beach.
